notes: Ethereum mainnet SIMD Launchpad preset. Resolve $poolManager to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the freshly deployed SIMDTEST. The deploying factory must initialize atomically and perform the 10% dead-address / 80% pool / 10% swarm allocation. Mine hook flags 0x20cc. The factory derives the actual opening price from launch economics. Hook fees stay in IMD: 0.5% to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985 plus a 30%-to-0% ten-block anti-snipe donation to in-range LPs. The launchpad handles the 1% creator fee externally; this hook never duplicates it.
